statements.t: These results strengthen our confidence in ATR-COSF’s potential as a differentiated cosmetic ingredient and set the stage for a first-in-human cosmetic study, with initial results anticipated by year-end.”
We are encouraged by the potential to reach additional patient populations and look forward to reporting topline data from Cohort 1, which we anticipate in the fourth quarter of 2026.”

Salva concluded: “The remainder of 2026 has the potential to be a defining period for Azitra as we expect to report initial results from our first in-human cosmetic study of ATR-COSF and topline data from Cohort 1 of our ATR-04 Phase 1/2 trial.
